result_text:
The region overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. The change is one SQL `ORDER BY` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (around line 10021). It is the same expression the sales-rep list already uses, and the docstring is updated to match.

`listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` has one caller, `RegionManagerService.overviewFor`, so nothing else changes. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before.

`RegionManagerTest` passes offline. Its only ticket case has a single open ticket, so it does not exercise the ordering. I did not add a test for the ordering or run your T-1 to T-5 example, so that ordering is verified by reading the SQL, not by a test. Nothing is committed.
